title: Simultaneous Merging
definition: Applying multiple task-specific adapters to a fresh base model at once, rather than sequentially.

difficulty_levels.beginner: Instead of adding one adapter at a time, we combine all adapters together, like mixing paints, to create a more balanced integration of knowledge.
difficulty_levels.intermediate: Simultaneous merging allows parallel, specialized skills to be integrated at the same time, reducing the influence of the last adapter on the final model.
difficulty_levels.expert: Simultaneous merging treats adapters as a unified set of knowledge, minimizing the overinfluence of the last adapter during the merging process, and creating a more holistic model.

extra_fields.insight: A novel approach to catastrophic forgetting, where new knowledge is integrated simultaneously instead of sequentially.
